Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D game creature sprite, separate transparent RGBA PNG.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the hand-painted gouache look, navy charcoal outer contour, softly brushed silver belly, muted colors, readable broad light/shadow masses and restrained fin rays. Design a distinct species silhouette. Keep the handmade dark-underwater fantasy game character quality, not photorealism or a glossy 3D fish.
Composition: ONE complete fish in exact right-facing side orthographic view, head RIGHT, tail LEFT, straight horizontal neutral swimming pose, mouth CLOSED at rest. Centered, complete silhouette, generous transparent padding on all sides. No environment, ground, cast shadow, halo, text, labels, swatches, grids, or extra parts. Actual transparent background.
Art direction: coherent natural anatomy, flowing body-to-head transition, understated curved gill slit in matching midtone; small expressive dark eye with a modest warm ivory iris and one tiny glint; NO giant bright ring or black C-shaped gill border. Fins taper into the skin with their roots hidden. Clean readable outer silhouette and 3 large value zones, soft warm pale underside, no tiny noisy scales, no armor or spikes. Keep contrast useful when reduced to 45–90 pixels. Organic painted surfaces rather than pieces outlined like cutouts.
SPECIES BRIEF: Cheirolepis, early ray-finned predator. A fast streamlined ochre olive-bronze fish, long low wedge-shaped skull with a substantial CLOSED toothed jaw and alert eye. Fairly slender body, long narrowing peduncle. Asymmetrical heterocercal caudal fin: distinctly longer upper lobe sweeping left and up, smaller lower lobe; graceful, not sharklike. Dorsal fin set well back near tail, anal opposite it; small paired fins underneath. Muted olive-gold back, soft brown-olive flank, warm pearl cream underside, ochre gray translucent fins. The outer silhouette must convey an active primitive hunter, not the round playerfish. Whole fish length about 4.7 times trunk depth, excluding tall fins. Teeth barely peek at closed mouth, no open gape.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent RGBA production BODY texture for a deformable fish rig.
Image 1 is the exact new fish art to edit; preserve that species' head, trunk, narrowing tail stalk, caudal tail fin, colors, hand painting, outline weight, overall horizontal pose and proportions. Image 2 ONLY explains the intended separation of a body texture, never copy its shape or gray palette.
Create ONE continuous body/head/caudal-tail cutout, RIGHT facing, actual transparent background and transparent padding. REMOVE the dorsal, anal, pectoral and pelvic fins completely; smoothly repaint the body surfaces underneath their roots. KEEP the CAUDAL TAIL and the correct original asymmetric or symmetric shape.
REMOVE the eyeball, socket, glint, gill slit and all gill-cover outlines, replacing them with smooth continuous painted skin. Remove the lower jaw/chin below the closed mouth line, leaving a shallow open notch under the upper lip from jaw hinge to snout, as in the separation example. NO mouth interior, teeth, eye, gill detail, other fins or detached parts. Repaint any fin seams. The head must join the trunk seamlessly with no collar. Keep the broad pale belly/light mass and darker back. No extra scales, pattern, labeling, lighting halos, ground or shadows. This is a body-only rig texture, not a whole finished fish.

Root has no dark transverse closing seam, it tucks under the body. One isolated fin, generous TRANSPARENT padding, no fish, no other parts, no text, no halo or ground.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: separate production transparent PNG fin for the right-facing Gillicus fish in image 1. Image 2 is only the painterly material style and outline reference. Paint ONE long low swept ANAL FIN, isolated, from the rear underside of Gillicus. Attachment edge is horizontal at TOP, extending broadly from left to right and tucking into the belly. The forward end is RIGHT with a moderately tall soft pointed leading lobe descending DOWN, membrane sweeps back to LEFT as a very low tapering ribbon ending at LEFT. Overall membrane width roughly FOUR times height, not a downward triangle, not a pectoral leaf. Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: isolated painted lower jaw for a 2D game rig. Image 1 shows Xiphactinus whose heavy lower jaw we need as a SEPARATE piece. Image 2 shows the desired separation, not its slender proportions. Paint ONLY a robust Xiphactinus LOWER JAW facing right, neutral horizontal closed orientation. Pivot/root at LEFT, lip/chin at RIGHT. The root must be broad and fleshy so it overlaps inside cheek, the front chin blunt rounded and projecting slightly upward; thick deep belly curves underneath from root to tip. Strong irregular natural oblique upper lip, not a thin banana, canoe or blade. Slate blue-gray outer skin fading to warm pearl-gray lower chin; tiny darkest muted lip band on upper rim. NO teeth (code renders conical teeth), NO mouth cavity, tongue or red membrane, NO head, eye or fin. Hand-painted gouache and charcoal-blue contour matching this fish, softer root with no transverse black closing outline. One isolated piece with generous actual transparent padding, no glow, cast shadow, labels or backdrop.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: isolated upper palatine fang sprite for Enchodus. From the fish reference, isolate and paint ONLY ONE long slender slightly recurved OFF-WHITE FANG with a small concealed gray-blue gum root on TOP and a very sharp tapered point DOWN. The tooth on the original skull is the identity reference. Warm ivory convex outer surface, cool slate-blue shadow on its back edge, fine dark charcoal contour; clearly a fish fang, not a huge dinosaur tooth, horn or knife. Slight backward curve towards LEFT at lower tip for a right-facing fish. Root small and blunt, no floating black border across it. Hand-painted gouache matching the original fish. One single tooth centered vertically with lots of genuinely transparent space, no other anatomy, jaw, fish, text, glow, shadow or background.
